units: <cite ref="Chullin 58b:2">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>לית די׳ בת שתא</he> (Ar. <he>דד׳</he>) no fly lives a whole year.
<cite ref="Berakhot 44a:4">Ber. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דהוה שריק ליה דו׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דשריא … דור׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) so that a fly would glide down his (fat and smooth) face.—
<cite ref="Gittin 86b:15">Gitt. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>דִּידְבְתָא דביני כיפי</he> a large fly found among sheaves.
